'Copy 3 s later' = the same prints entered ~delay+3 s later at the then-mid plus half the spread, fee paid, held to resolution (src/fasttier.py net_cols follow_res).
A_source.note: Aug 2026 appears in both periods: IS matches started before 2026-08-25 14:15 UTC, OOS after. Oct 2026 is 3 days. The fast tier's own prints are not v2 and not ours.

B_size.what: Frozen v2 book, causal window, held to resolution. Per share and per $ of notional (bps). Gross = payout minus fill price; fee = rate x q(1-q) of the match's own taker fee; no slippage is modelled at fast-tier fills (they already crossed the spread), so +0.5c and +1c worse-entry rows are shown from the committed stress.

committed.label: Fama-French 3 + momentum on v2 daily returns, weekdays with factor data; period 2026-02-02 to 2026-08-31 (the last 7 days are burned OOS)

C_factor_neutral.reading: No factor explains the P&L: largest factor |t| = 1.33, R2 = 3.3% (IS-only calendar-day spec 2.3%).

D_where.label: measured at the fast tier's own fill prices: the opportunity at their speed, not our execution
D_where.what: Descriptive splits of the frozen v2 trades. Net c/share is share-weighted; 95% CI = match-clustered bootstrap (1,000 draws). Price deciles use IS decile edges for both periods (intervals open on the left, prices are on a 1c tick so deciles are not equal-count).
D_where.side_market_type: n/a: v2 trades only the match-winner moneyline (side markets were traded only by maker v1, which failed its blind OOS test; see I).

IS.label: in sample (IS)
IS.reading_win_rate: Held to resolution each trade pays 0 or 1: the share-weighted win rate 52.5% vs an average price paid of 50.6c is the gross edge; wins and losses are about the same size per share.

OOS.label: burned OOS (non-blind for v2; held-out matches from 2026-08-25 14:15 UTC)
OOS.reading_win_rate: Held to resolution each trade pays 0 or 1: the share-weighted win rate 53.9% vs an average price paid of 52.4c is the gross edge; wins and losses are about the same size per share.

within_a_point.what: Net 30 s markout (c/share, after fee) by seconds since jump DETECTION, tennis moneylines, match-clustered 95% CI. From the committed TT5 decay run.
within_a_point.resolution_note: Tape timestamps are block times in whole seconds (median 1.98 s after the true trade), so the 0.25-1 s bins are empty by construction; '0 s' = same block second as detection. The requested 0-0.5/0.5-1 s split is not resolvable on these tapes.

OOS.label: burned OOS (non-blind; read by scripts/signal_decay.py, already logged)

within_a_point.reading: The fast tier earns most in the detection second (+1.18c IS, +0.75c OOS) and about half that one second later (+0.59c IS, +0.41c OOS). OOS its 2-9 s bins are -0.02 / -0.66 / -0.05c. Everyone else is below zero in every bin (max -0.86c).

over_calendar_time.what: Fast-tier net 30 s markout by month (A), OLS on month index (0 = 2025-12), unweighted.

IS_plus_OOS_rows.note: OOS rows appended in calendar order; Aug has an IS and an OOS row; Oct is 3 days

over_calendar_time.reading: The edge is shrinking: the fast tier's net 30 s markout averaged 1.90c over Dec-Mar and 0.71c over the last four rows (Aug IS - Oct), a fitted -0.17c per month, while qualifying wallets grew from 4 to 131 and the venue moved from a 3 s delay / no fee to 1 s / 5% (docs/NOTE.md section 1). It stayed positive every month.

F_concentration.label: measured at the fast tier's own fill prices: the opportunity at their speed, not our execution
F_concentration.what: Share of v2 P&L carried by the top 1/5/10 copied wallets, matches and days (sum of the top-k units' P&L / period P&L; above 100% means the rest lost money).

OOS.label: burned OOS (non-blind for v2; held-out matches from 2026-08-25 14:15 UTC)

F_concentration.reading: OOS is concentrated: the top 5 of 86 copied wallets carry 142% of OOS P&L (IS 81%); without them OOS v2 earns -0.34c/share. Clustered by wallet, the OOS CI includes zero.

G_tier_ladder.what: Who earns what per share, fastest to slowest. Horizons differ by row and are stated.

rows.reading: By the time a public score arrives the book has already moved (median 44.52 s earlier). Prices are close to calibrated: the bin's mean price lies inside the win-rate CI in 8/11 IS and 11/11 OOS bins; the favourite-bias test (H2) found no edge after fees.

H_capacity.label: IS and burned OOS (the size-scaled OOS rows are non-blind evaluations already logged)
H_capacity.what: Frozen v2 with every size cap scaled by the multiplier, same walk-forward fitting; no price-impact model beyond never taking more than the copied print (larger rows would be worse in reality).

capacity_estimate.statement: On the burned OOS, $/day peaks at 1x and the largest size still positive is 2x; every larger size loses. Capacity is about $23k-$34k of capital.
capacity_estimate.superseded: The sizing lens's '~$100k at Sharpe ~6' (docs/NOTE.md section 6) used onset labels, was IS only, and its $102k row was the copy-everything baseline.
